title: The reckoning at the works
premise: Standing: the Slagworks Crew have decided what you are, and this is their ground.

stages.narration: Two of them step out of the sheet-metal shadow ahead of you and a third closes the gap behind, unhurried, the way people move when the arithmetic is already done. Nobody says your name. Nobody has to — word runs the length of the Ironworks faster than you walk it, and it got here first.

choices.label: Put down what you're carrying and back out of the works

effects.note: paid off the Slagworks Crew to walk out of the Ironworks

choices.label: You've come too far to be turned around — stand
Take the gap behind the third one and run

notes: T86 · the low-standing cash-out, sited on the REGION rather than the faction's home node: measured before this task, the Foundry itself is stood on in 0% of ordinary runs, so a homeNode gate would have constrained an empty set. One-shot, so it pre-empts the ambient tier once — the district stops being background.
